rows.Kwic: 第三句能令人大徹大悟，不敢舉，恐汝等皆大徹大悟，打筋斗去了，叫那箇守這禪堂？

Override.AttributionNote: 天界覺浪盛禪師語錄, hall address on Linji's three phrases and Juelang's proposed fourth. Juelang Daosheng is the exact speaker: he jokes that he dares not raise his third phrase because it would make everyone thoroughly awaken and leave nobody to guard the Chan hall.

rows.Kwic: 僧問巴陵：「如何是提婆宗？」陵曰：「銀碗裏盛雪。」

Override.AttributionNote: 天界覺浪盛禪師語錄, Juelang Daosheng's old-case verse on Baling's Kanadeva-school exchange. Baling Haojian is the exact speaker of the stored answer, 'snow heaped in a silver bowl'; Juelang is the later verse author.
